meaning.th: เสียง ชิ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: สีขาว/ปราสาท → ชิ-โระ

description.en: A swooping spirit with a curved tail, like a fish hook. It dives down and snaps upward — always catching the syllable 'shi' in mid-air.

mnemonic.en: し looks like a fish hook — it curves down and snaps up at the end.

meaning.th: เสียง นุ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ตุ๊กตาผ้า → นุ-อิ-กุ-รุ-มิ

description.en: A fluffy, looping spirit with a tangled tail. It wraps itself around things it likes — always warm, always soft, always leaving a little loop behind.

mnemonic.en: ぬ looks like thread looping over itself — imagine sewing a stuffed toy.

meaning.th: เสียง โมะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ป่า → โมะ-ริ

description.en: A fluffy spirit that collects things wherever it goes. The two horizontal bars across its body are like branches — and it always has something hooked on them.

mnemonic.en: も looks like a fishhook with two catches — it's always picking something up as it passes.

meaning.th: เสียง โวะ (อนุภาคกรรม ในภาษาญี่ปุ่น)

examples.sentence: ほんをよむ (hon wo yomu = to read a book)

translation.th: อ่านหนังสือ → ฮอน-โวะ-โยะ-มุ
translation.en: to read a book → hon wo yo-mu

description.en: A rare, looping spirit that exists only to connect. を is almost never used as a sound — it lives between words, marking what the action is directed at.

mnemonic.en: を has a wide circle with a tail — like a lasso reaching out to grab the object of an action.
